name: the-process
description: The Process — a personal day-trading discipline, journaling, and research tool. Local, single-user.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n proxy,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -n proxy,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
